In [[3017 BBY]], [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] launched an '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]]. During the battle, Corellian [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] defeated [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]]. The defeat prompted the Republic to declare war on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
